name: Ollama
tagline: Run LLMs locally — llama, qwen, mistral
description: Local LLM runtime. Pull models with one command and serve them on an OpenAI-compatible API. Headless service: pair it with Open WebUI for a chat interface.
compose:
services:
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.api_port}}:11434"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.models_dir}}:/root/.ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
